an10.81:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Campāyaṃ viharati Gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
an10.81:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Bāhuno yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Bāhuno Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an10.81:1.3: ‘katīhi nu kho bhante dhammehi Tathāgato nissaṭo visaṃyutto vippamutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharatī' ti? 2.
an10.81:2.1: Dasahi kho Bāhuna dhammehi Tathāgato nissaṭo visaṃyutto vippamutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharati.
an10.81:2.3: Rūpena kho Bāhuna Tathāgato nissaṭo visaṃyutto vippamutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharati.
an10.81:2.12: Kilesehi kho Bāhuna Tathāgato nissaṭo visaṃyutto vippamutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharati. 4.
an10.81:2.13: Seyyathā pi Bāhuna uppalaṃ vā padumaṃ vā puṇḍarīkaṃ vā udake jātaṃ udake saṃvaḍḍhaṃ udakā accuggamma tiṭṭhati anupalittaṃ udakena,
an10.81:2.14: evam eva kho Bāhuna imehi dasahi dhammehi Tathāgato nissaṭo visaṃyutto vippamutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharatī
